spec.description:
Bradford Fireseal Party Wall Batts are non-combustible stone
wool insulation batts specifically designed for Class 1 inter-tenancy wall
systems to fill and seal vertical joints, supporting fire protection
requirements in multi-residential applications. Manufactured from molten natural
rock and blast furnace slag bonded with thermosetting resin, these 100mm thick
batts have remarkable resistance to shrinkage under fire conditions. Pre-cut
to 1200mm x 168mm, they are installed under 10% compression in vertical wall
cavities to prevent fire spread between adjoining dwellings.
features: Non-combustible stone wool construction complying with AS 1530.1
Purpose-designed for vertical joint sealing in Class 1 inter-tenancy walls

Pre-cut to 1200mm x 168mm x 100mm for fast and consistent on-site
installation

Exceptional resistance to shrinkage under extreme fire
temperatures up to 1000°C

Stacks neatly to fill wall cavities up to 255mm in
height per unit

Performance
unaffected by contact with water

Provides thermal and acoustic benefits while
fulfilling NCC passive fire requirements

install:
For
vertical joint applications only in Class 1 inter-tenancy wall systems

Friction-fit batts into the vertical joint maintaining a minimum of 10%
compression
Ensure batts are seated tightly against both wall leaves

When
extending length, make a Vee profile cut to both ends of each batt to create a
tight interlocking butt joint

When stacking layers to fill cavities up
to 255mm, stagger vertical joints and install as one consolidated unit

Do not
use to seal areas at the top of wall systems (use Party Wall Sealer for wall
heads)
selection_checklist:
Verify application is for vertical joints
in Class 1 inter-tenancy/party walls

Measure cavity width to ensure 100mm
batt achieves 10-15% compression

Calculate total vertical lineal metres
needed (each pack provides 6 linear metres)

Confirm wall system is approved
for Fireseal Party Wall Batts (timber frame, steel stud, or masonry)
limitations:
For vertical joints only; not appropriate
to seal areas at the top of a masonry or lightweight wall system

Maximum 3
layers should be stacked without adequate intermediate mechanical support
Must be protected from continuous water pooling and direct UV exposure

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Fireseal Party Wall Batts are purpose-made,
non-combustible stone wool insulation batts measuring 100mm x 1200mm x 168mm
(product code 119161) designed exclusively to seal vertical joints in Class 1
inter-tenancy party walls. Engineered from high-temperature bio-soluble
rockwool, they resist shrinkage at temperatures up to 1000°C and maintain fire
integrity between adjoining townhouses and duplexes. Installed under 10%
compression and compliant with AS 1530.1, they satisfy NCC Deemed-to-Satisfy
provisions for separating wall fire containment.
